page.notes: Scan edge cuts off the left-hand margin, so most marginal notes and the first letters of several lines are unreadable; these are marked [illegible] or [?]. Greek readings are tentative. The Greek line after the Odyssey quotation and the Greek in the Incola paragraph may differ from the printed form. The left-margin references "36", "38.", "al.", "NOCIÆ al." and "259" are only partly visible. Handwriting at the foot of the page ("Ssi 2" and "A. Advena") is not printed text and was left out. The number at the head is read as IOI with an uncertain last numeral. Lines of the first paragraph and the marked gaps in the Pomponius passage are uncertain and should be checked against the original.
